extensionDescription.message: Standalone active sync: alarms, native Get New Messages (Experiment), new-mail reply hints, optional HTTP report.
extensionDescription.description: Short description for manifest and AMO.

optPollAll.message: On each tick: fetch all accounts (all-accounts check mail)

optMonitorAllFolders.message: Listen for new mail in all folders

optSettleMs.message: Wait after fetch before Inbox tab fallback (ms)

optReportUrl.message: Report URL (POST JSON, empty to disable)

optReportIncludeBody.message: Include plain + HTML body in report (minimal-server webhook / Notion)

optReportSecret.message: Webhook shared secret (optional; sent as X-TB-Receiver-Secret)

optMailTabFallback.message: If no new-mail event after fetch: switch mail tab to each Inbox

optPermissionDenied.message: Origin permission not granted; report may fail until allowed.

optionsPermissionHint.message: Saving a report URL may prompt for network permission for that site.
